response.explanation: Computes average latency_ms of failed (non-SUCCESS) attempts per failure category over the past two years (2024-10-31 to 2026-10-31), restricted to the resolved failure categories.
response.sql: SELECT failure_category, AVG(latency_ms) AS avg_latency_ms, COUNT(*) AS failed_attempts FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-10-31' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' AND status <> 'SUCCESS' AND failure_category IN ('customer_dropoff', 'issuer_decline', 'technical', 'risk_decline') GROUP BY failure_category ORDER BY failure_category LIMIT 50
